prompts.bottleneck: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: a polished full-width editorial engineering illustration for a Chinese longform about US data center power. Input images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY, not edit targets and not actual project photographs. Match their realistic engineering cutaway style, delicate contour lines, warm white background, soft daylight, high fidelity concrete/steel/copper materials, legible large assemblies. New scene: illustrate a regional grid bottleneck between available generation and a newly built data center. Landscape 3:2 composition filled usefully without huge empty upper margin. Left: a generic gas-fired power station at distant low relief. Middle: high-voltage transmission towers crossing terrain, ending at an existing compact fenced substation. A parallel new transformer bay clearly under construction with unfinished foundation and one yellow crane, no power flow through the unfinished bay. Right: a white data center building with a restrained cutaway showing server racks, switchgear and blue cooling water circuit. Clearly separate transmission cables from water pipes; electrical supply to building travels via insulated conduit from completed substation, not exposed copper tubes on racks. No labels, text, symbols, numbers, logos, clocks, money, or claims about capacity. This is a generic mechanism illustration, not a map, not a specific US site. Keep geometry coherent, organized focal hierarchy, approximately six main assemblies. Show the construction bottleneck through the unfinished transformer bay, not cartoon blockage or dramatic blackout. Entire scene on clean warm-white, subtle ground vignette, no blue poster background. Use all three reference images only to guide polish and cutaway readability.

prompts.gas: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: realistic engineering illustration for a Chinese editorial article explaining onsite gas power for data centers. Reference image is visual style only, not edit target or actual site photograph. New scene: landscape 3:2 with the same immaculate warm white ground, precise fine-line realistic steel/concrete components and restrained colored flow arrows. Show natural gas arriving via a fixed underground PIPELINE from bottom-left, not a truck. It comes above ground into a coherent gas pressure regulation and metering skid with yellow pipe, then enters an enclosed reciprocating engine-generator unit, with side cutaway showing engine coupled axially to generator and exhaust/flue clearly venting upwards. Clearly labeled in small clean Chinese text only: above incoming pipeline '管道天然气', above skid '调压与计量', above unit '燃气内燃机发电', above receiving data center '园区供配电'. Keep these four labels exact, legible and separate from machinery. Generator electrical output runs through a clearly visible SWITCHGEAR CABINET via insulated cables to the data center on right. The data center restrained cutaway shows a few server racks and separate blue water cooling loop. Yellow arrows for gas, purple arrows for electric cable only, do not show electricity as yellow gas tube entering server racks. No diesel or gas truck, no fuel cell stacks, no turbine mislabeled as engine, no capacity numbers, brand names, logos, smoke clouds or spectacular lighting. Generic engineering mechanism, not a real project. Compact clear assemblies filling the frame, no giant white upper margin; no extra inset panels or text boxes. High detail but simple chain, visual focus on gas supply → generation → electrical switchgear → racks.
